newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki seen flat to lower after tame U.S. rise.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki seen flat to lower after tame U.S. rise.

text.p: Shares were seen starting flat to slightly easier on Tuesday, after the Dow industrials ended just over one point higher on Monday and Nokia finished in New York a few markka below its Helsinki close, brokers said.
"I think we could open down a bit," one broker said. But he nonetheless predicted a flat trend for the session after Monday's 0.88 percent rise in the FOX index.
"We've been rising for over two weeks straight, at some point this has to flatten out," the broker said.
Forestries were seen providing support, after U.S. paper stocks rose more than one percent overnight, brokers said.

A year-on-year increase of 1.1 percent in domestic June CPI and a 6.1 percent year-on-year rise in Finnish May industrial output were unsurprising, and unlikely to have any impact on the stock market, brokers said.
